text:
sophia (Eng): Hey team — noticed my Feb 15 paycheck shows state withholding for BOTH CA and NY even though I updated my address to NY on Feb 1. Also housing stipend paid twice. Can someone look?

jane (People Ops): Ugh, thanks for flagging. Can you DM your employee ID and full name so we can pull the run? cc @raj (Payroll)

sophia (Eng): DMd — emp ID 54321, Sophia L., relocated 2026-02-01. Thanks.

raj (Payroll): I see the run. There's a duplicate housing stipend line and two state allocation lines (CA + NY) for pay period ending 2026-02-15. Looks like the relocation flow didn't clear the legacy CA domicile flag.

marta (Finance): We can approve an off-cycle reversal for the duplicate stipend payment. Need HR confirmation and payroll estimate of tax withholding adjustments before we schedule. Limit approved up to $2,000 in reversal without exec sign-off.

raj (Payroll): Estimating reversal net: about $1,450 gross duplication, with combined state withholding ~$120. We'll run an off-cycle reversal payroll on 2026-03-03 pending approval. Also need direction on W-2 handling if totals change for the year.

sophia (Eng): Thanks — timeline works. If W-2s are affected, how long until a corrected W-2 (W-2c)?

jane (People Ops): If the reversal posts and changes year-to-date withholding materially, we'll prepare a W-2c in the next tax reporting window. Payroll + Finance will confirm if a W-2c is required after finalizing the reversal. We'll notify you via DM and this thread.

raj (Payroll): I'll schedule the off-cycle reversal and include state withholding adjustments. Quick snippet of what I'll run in payroll system:

```
RUN_ID: offcycle-2026-03-03
EMP: 54321
LINE_ADJ: housing_stipend_reverse -1450.00
STATE_ALLOC: NY only (100%)
TAX_ADJ: recompute federal + state per run
```

raj (Payroll): Also created internal ticket PR-7892 for the domicile flag bug so it doesn't recur.

jane (People Ops): Confirmed PR-7892. Submitted to Payroll Ops for fix and documentation update. @payroll-bot can you post status updates?

payroll-bot: PR-7892: created by jane. Status: In Progress. Owner: raj. ETA: 48 hours.

raj (Payroll): Note for Sophia — if both states withheld for Feb you may be due a refund or credit depending on NY/CA reciprocity rules and filing status. Keep copies of pay stubs; we'll include guidance in the follow-up DM.

sophia (Eng): Appreciate it. One last Q: Do I need to update anything in ADP or is HR doing the address change?

jane (People Ops): We updated the payroll domicile flag on our side when you submitted the relocation form, but that secondary flag didn't clear correctly. Payroll will correct the system flag and I'll follow up to confirm ADP mirrors the change.

jane (People Ops): Final note — I'll post when reversal is scheduled and when PR-7892 is closed. Thanks for the quick responses. :pray:
